name: Aspect of Manticore — "When this Aura enters, enchanted creature gains first strike until end of turn" is not static
notes: Memory: project_cant_rules_and_goaded_as_traits_2026-10-13 (follow-up). enchantAbilityRegex read the enters trigger as a static grant, so the enchanted creature had first strike for good. It now skips trigger lines of an unfired permanent. Same for Captain's Tutelage, Fire-Rim Form, Military Discipline, Super Speed, Gilt-Leaf's Embrace, Accelerated Evolution, Starlit Mantle, Sentinel's Mark, Maze's Mantle, Item Shopkeep, Earthbind.
